production_characteristics: Go control plane with revision, idempotency, and generation authority
C++ epoll dataplane with real TCP forwarding and PROXY protocol v2
Two-phase prepare/activate rollout with live-session quorum
Immutable versioned snapshots with canonical digests end to end
Health-aware target eligibility, draining, and zonal fail-open policy
Dataplane checkpoint recovery after restart and corrupt CURRENT pointers
Bounded readiness, metrics, rollout, and audit operator surfaces

stateful_dataset_exemption.reason: Sovereign LB is a network control and dataplane service whose persisted state is immutable listener/target snapshots, generation checkpoints, rollout records, node session fences, and health runtime—not a fixed business-record warehouse. Seeding 10,000–20,000 synthetic business rows would not participate in TCP forwarding, quorum rollout, or checkpoint recovery. Production statefulness is exercised through the 24-node fleet inventory, scenario catalog, loopback lab backends, and verifier-driven apply/prepare/activate/restart flows.

domain_state_model: compiled immutable generation snapshots and digests
rollout phase and per-node session acknowledgements
dataplane active runtime and connection ownership
target health, ejection, drain, and incarnation runtime
padded generation checkpoints and CURRENT pointer
production_authenticity.reachability_evidence: All declared state is created, mutated, or inspected through /app/sovereign-lb/bin/lb-control-plane, /app/sovereign-lb/bin/lb-dataplane, /app/sovereign-lb/bin/lbctl, and the loopback lab entrypoints documented under /app/sovereign-lb/docs.
